name: Viva.com
description:
About Viva.com

Viva.com is the first Tech Bank in Europe for businesses, serving 29 countries through its pan-European critical infrastructure for payments & banking services.

Viva.com’s offering spans across omnichannel payment acceptance, deposit accounts, card issuing, and a broad suite of financing solutions - including working capital and advance booking financing - alongside fiscalisation services, giving businesses across all verticals access to the tools they need to run their operations efficiently, on a single integrated platform.

Viva.com pioneered and leads in Tap on Any Device technology, enabling acceptance on any Android device or iPhone, while connecting directly to all major international and local card schemes, local payment systems, and alternative payment methods across Europe.

jobs.title: AML/CFT Investigator
jobs.description:
Viva.com is the first Tech Bank in Europe for businesses, serving 29 countries through its pan-European critical infrastructure for payments & banking services.

Viva.com’s offering spans across omnichannel payment acceptance, deposit accounts, card issuing, and a broad suite of financing solutions - including working capital and advance booking financing - alongside fiscalisation services, giving businesses across all verticals access to the tools they need to run their operations efficiently, on a single integrated platform.

Viva.com pioneered and leads in Tap on Any Device technology, enabling acceptance on any Android device or iPhone, while connecting directly to all major international and local card schemes, local payment systems, and alternative payment methods across Europe. 

The Role

Viva.com is strengthening its Anti-Financial Crime Unit and is looking for an AML/CFT Investigator to support ongoing efforts to enhance our control environment. The role combines traditional investigative work with the use of AI-assisted analytical tools, and is fully on-site to enable close collaboration with AFC, Data and Technology teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct high-quality AML/CFT investigations across transaction monitoring alerts, sanctions/PEP hits and unusual customer activity, ensuring well-supported and defensible conclusions.
  • Use AI-powered tools — including large language models (LLMs), anomaly detection and graph analytics — to identify patterns, enhance investigative analysis and improve risk assessments.
  • Contribute to refining detection rules, risk scoring models and automated triage processes by providing structured feedback and insights.
  • Prepare clear, accurate and well-documented case narratives and SAR/STR reports, supported by AI drafting tools where appropriate.
  • Participate in AI governance initiatives, ensuring transparency, explainability and responsible human oversight in AI-assisted investigations.
  • Work closely with AFC, Product, Data and Technology teams through daily on-site collaboration, enabling faster knowledge-sharing and reinforcing overall investigative quality.

At Viva.com, we believe in amplifying human potential through AI. When you join us, you're stepping into a future-forward environment where technology empowers every role, driving smarter, more efficient. 

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in AML/CFT investigations, transaction monitoring or related AFC roles, ideally within fintech, payments or banking.
  • Strong understanding of AML/CFT regulatory frameworks (FATF, EU AMLD, EBA/ECB guidelines) and ability to apply them pragmatically.
  • Willingness to work with AI-assisted investigation tools; prior exposure is a plus but not required.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex information and identify meaningful patterns.
  • Excellent written communication skills and ability to draft clear, structured investigation narratives.
  • Collaborative and curious mindset, comfortable working in a cross-functional environment.
  • Readiness to work full-time on-site and contribute actively to a high-quality, learning-oriented investigative culture.
  • Additional experience with graph analytics, QA/QC, CAMS/ICA certifications or basic SQL/Python knowledge is considered beneficial.

Benefits

💸 Competitive compensation package;

🎯Annual bonus based on your performance and targets' achievement;

🏥 Private health insurance for you and your family;

💻 Top of the Line tools and equipment;

📚 Career development and regular feedback to develop your skills;

🏃🏽‍♂️ Employee Wellness Program like Daily group sessions led by professional coaches.

jobs.title: Anti-Fraud Investigator
jobs.description:
Viva.com is the first Tech Bank in Europe for businesses, serving 29 countries through its pan-European critical infrastructure for payments & banking services.

Viva.com’s offering spans across omnichannel payment acceptance, deposit accounts, card issuing, and a broad suite of financing solutions - including working capital and advance booking financing - alongside fiscalisation services, giving businesses across all verticals access to the tools they need to run their operations efficiently, on a single integrated platform.

Viva.com pioneered and leads in Tap on Any Device technology, enabling acceptance on any Android device or iPhone, while connecting directly to all major international and local card schemes, local payment systems, and alternative payment methods across Europe.

The Role

This role focuses on conducting daily anti-fraud investigations across card issuing, acquiring, and bank account payments. Working closely with internal teams and leveraging modern technologies and AI-driven solutions, the position helps identify fraud patterns, strengthen controls, and ensure effective detection and prevention across the EEA.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Handle day-to-day anti-fraud investigations for card issuing/acquiring and bank account payments across countries within the European Economic Area (EEA);
  • Utilize industry “best practices” and relevant tools to review transactional data and other information to assess the risk of fraud for specific transactions or individuals;
  • Develop and maintain effective communication with colleagues and customers throughout the investigation process;
  • Collaborate closely with data science and risk teams to provide valuable feedback on observed fraud patterns and trends;
  • Suggest and implement anti-fraud rules and controls within multiple systems to improve detection and prevention mechanisms;
  • Leverage AI and machine learning tools to enhance fraud detection processes, automate pattern recognition, and improve investigation efficiency.

At Viva.com, we believe in amplifying human potential through AI. When you join us, you're stepping into a future-forward environment where technology empowers every role, driving smarter, more efficient. 

Requirements

  • Minimum of 1-2 years of working experience in end-to-end anti-fraud analysis, investigation, prevention, detection, and handling for card issuing/acquiring and bank account payments;
  • Prior experience in communicating with customers regarding fraud-related issues;
  • Strong knowledge of schemes associations' risk management requirements and guidelines, with a minimum understanding of MasterCard & Visa standards;
  • Up-to-date knowledge of current fraud patterns, trends, and emerging fraud techniques;
  • Excellent command of the English language, both written and verbal;  
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.);
  • Familiarity with AI tools and technologies used for fraud detection and prevention.

Benefits

As a BI Engineer you will play a key role in designing and optimizing the data foundations that power our advanced analytics, AI, and agentic capabilities.   • Continuously expand technical knowledge and expertise.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field.

  • Experience preparing AI/LLM-ready datasets and supporting ML/agentic pipelines.

Viva.com pioneered and leads in Tap on Any Device technology, enabling acceptance on any Android device or iPhone, while connecting directly to all major international and local card schemes, local payment systems, and alternative payment methods across Europe.

The Role

The COL Analyst is responsible for the end-to-end management of client onboarding activities, legalization processes, and loan request activities within the Client Onboarding & Lending team. This role operates at the intersection of compliance, operational excellence, and AI-powered investigation, leveraging advanced AI tools, to ensure accuracy, regulatory adherence, and efficiency across all case types.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute client onboarding activities in line with company policies and regulatory requirements, ensuring accuracy and completeness;
  • Perform quality checks on identity verification processes, including review of flagged cases;
  • Collect and validate customer data, ensuring completeness and resolving missing information when needed;
  • Conduct investigations (e.g. representation & UBO checks) to ensure compliance when automated processes are insufficient;
  • Maintain up-to-date and compliant customer records through ongoing and ad-hoc reviews;
  • Participate in data quality controls and reporting reviews, taking corrective actions where necessary;
  • Conduct manual legalization investigations and ensure proper documentation of all steps;
  • Verify contract documentation, including accuracy of customer signatures and completeness of required fields;
  • Support loan application processes, including data verification, case handling, and coordination with internal teams;
  • Manage cases and escalations, resolving customer requests within SLA and maintaining detailed documentation for audit purposes.

At Viva.com, we believe in amplifying human potential through AI. When you join us, you're stepping into a future-forward environment where technology empowers every role, driving smarter, more efficient. 

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Law, or a related field is preferred;
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in client onboarding, compliance operations, or a related role is preferred;
  • Experience with CRM or case management systems; Microsoft Dynamics 365 is preferred;
  • High attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and a process-oriented mindset;
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent cases while maintaining accuracy and meeting SLAs;
  • Proficiency in AI tools (e.g. Custom GPTs, ChatGPT) for investigations and the ability to critically apply outputs; experience with Dynamics 365, Power BI, and SharePoint is a plus;
  • Excellent command of both Greek and English, written and verbal; additional languages are an advantage.

jobs.title: Client Operations Representative
jobs.description:
As part of the Operations Team, you will play a key role in supporting merchant acquisition and business growth by identifying and qualifying new merchant opportunities, engaging prospective and existing merchants, and driving successful onboarding, activation, and long-term customer growth.

About viva.com

Viva.com is the 1st Tech Bank in Europe for Businesses revolutionizing omnichannel payment acceptance, offering card issuing, loans, and deposit accounts to businesses across Europe. Licensed by the Bank of Greece, it operates under the EU FOS regime in 29 EU countries, delivering seamless financial services. Viva.com is the first to pioneer and holds the top position in the Tap on Any Device technology, enabling payments acceptance on any device or even without a device. Today Viva.com is leading the transition to All-in-One business solutions, powered by its full suite of financial services. To that end, reflecting its holistic approach to business needs, Viva.com has built a dynamic ecosystem featuring over 450 tech partner-innovators in the software and hardware space. Connecting directly to all local payment schemes, alternative payment methods and payment systems across the continent, further strengthens Viva.com’s value proposition. Viva.com envisions to provide businesses a value-driven platform to accelerate the adoption of the latest technology.Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and generate new merchant opportunities through market research, referrals, digital channels, and other lead generation activities.
  • Qualify and manage inbound and outbound business opportunities generated through multiple acquisition channels.
  • Engage prospective merchants to understand their business needs and guide them through the onboarding journey.
  • Support merchant acquisition activities by collaborating closely with the Sales team throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Promote Viva.com's products and services, identifying opportunities to increase product adoption, customer value, and business growth.
  • Act as a key point of contact between merchants and internal departments to ensure a seamless onboarding and customer experience.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client information in the company's CRM and internal systems.
  • Monitor and analyze merchant account performance, proactively identifying opportunities for growth and retention.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure excellent service delivery and continuous process improvement.

Requirements

  • Experience in monitoring and analyzing account performance to drive growth;
  • Hold a strong interest in technology, with the desire to become a payments subject matter expert;
  • Be able to identify customer technical and commercial requirements to craft solutions;
  • Hold strong presentation skills, particularly over the phone or with video meetings;
  • Possesses collaboration skills, able to work with a wide range of people to get stuff done;
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese.

jobs.title: Client Relationship On-Field Representative

Special requirements:

  • Please note this is a field based role.
  • You will need a fully valid Slovenian or European driving licence and your own vehicle for this position.

Why Viva.com?

Viva.com is the 1st Tech Bank in Europe for Businesses revolutionizing omnichannel payment acceptance, offering card issuing, loans, and deposit accounts to businesses across Europe. Licensed by the Bank of Greece, it operates under the EU FOS regime in 22 EU countries, delivering seamless financial services. Role Overview: As a member of the Direct Representatives Team, you will play a crucial role in promoting company services directly to clients, ensuring seamless activation and ongoing support for merchants. 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Promote the company services by visiting clients’ premises;  
  • Assist merchants with verification and activation processes;  
  • Monitor and analyze portfolio performance;  
  • Provide in-person support and consultation for existing customers;  
  • Engage in both system-scheduled and self-initiated activities;  
  • Ensure new merchants in the assigned portfolio complete registration;  
  • Support existing merchants in maintaining active usage;  
  • Escalate issues by opening cases for problems beyond their resolution scope;  
  • Present product features and benefits to clients in a compelling manner;  
  • Travel to meet clients and attend industry events. 

Requirements

What we look for:

  • 2+ years of experience in business development within a fast-paced environment preferably a financial services institution, or to the retail / hospitality (Horeca) business verticals;

  • Experience in working with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; 
  • Outstanding negotiation skills; 
  • Strong organizational and diary management skills;

  • The ability to deal with a diverse client base;  
  • Computer literacy & tech mindset;  
  • Fluent in Slovenian and able to speak business level English.   

Benefits

  • Bonus, capped at an additional 18 months salary per annum.
  • Private medical health insurance.
  • Car and laptop allowances.
  • Mobile phone allowance.
  • Fuel and parking expense allowance.
  • A diverse multi-cultural working environment.

Requirements

  • Resiliency and the ability to handle objections;

  • Computer literacy & tech mindset;  
  • Fluent in English.   

Benefits

    • Basic salary of Euro 38,000 to 45,000 depending on experience and skills sets
    • Performance incentive payments, capped at 1.5 x base annual salary and paid monthly.

jobs.description:
Cient Relationship Representative focuses on actively seek in promoting company services directly to clients on field, ensuring seamless activation and ongoing support for merchants.

About viva.com

Viva.com is the 1st Tech Bank in Europe for Businesses revolutionizing omnichannel payment acceptance, offering card issuing, loans, and deposit accounts to businesses across Europe. Licensed by the Bank of Greece, it operates under the EU FOS regime in 29 EU countries, delivering seamless financial services. Viva.com is the first to pioneer and holds the top position in the Tap on Any Device technology, enabling payments acceptance on any device or even without a device. Today Viva.com is leading the transition to All-in-One business solutions, powered by its full suite of financial services. To that end, reflecting its holistic approach to business needs, Viva.com has built a dynamic ecosystem featuring over 450 tech partner-innovators in the software and hardware space. Connecting directly to all local payment schemes, alternative payment methods and payment systems across the continent, further strengthens Viva.com’s value proposition. Viva.com envisions to provide businesses a value-driven platform to accelerate the adoption of the latest technology.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Promote company services and onboard new merchants on field.
  • Assist merchants with verification and activation processes,
  • Monitor portfolio performance and address arising issues,
  • Present product features and benefits effectively,
  • Visit clients and attend industry events to strengthen relationships.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business development ideally in the payment sector. FMCG, Retail or any other relevant sales function would be also welcomed;
  • Ability to identify both business potential and added value in technology-driven commercial solutions;
  • Be a strong stakeholder with engagement skills and the ability to interact confidently with a wide variety of people at all levels;
  • Be able to work independently and as part of a team to deliver parallel projects;
  • Strong language skills with the ability to speak English and Portuguese at a business level.

Benefits

  • Permanent contract via an Employer of Record (EOR).
  • An attractive performance-based bonus (linked to individual targets and boosted by collective goals).
  • A comprehensive benefits package in addition to salary (Meal vouchers, allowances, car allowance, group medical plan coverage, etc).
